prose:
A low exterior tracking view reveals Resolute, a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel, crossing an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast. Its forward turrets finish training toward a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, distant on the horizon. The camera holds both ships in the same firing axis. Resolute fires one coordinated main-gun salvo: brilliant muzzle flashes, heavy barrel recoil, and expanding smoke. The camera trembles with the concussion, then steadies as smoke drifts above the deck. Do not show the enemy sinking yet.

BIBLE (use these words for these things, every time): captain_vale = a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout = a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman = a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; bridge = a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; sea = an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; resolute = a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel; enemy_cruiser = a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; tactical_screen = a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Light and grade: Cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, and warm amber screen light; realistic naval-war-film photography..
time: Late afternoon, moments after the fire order
sound_why: Environmental sound carries the action: turret machinery, ocean wash, one thunderous salvo, and its rolling echo. No dialogue or music is needed.
progression: Outside, our battleship fires its main guns at the enemy ship on the horizon.
carried: The enemy cruiser seen through the bridge windows now appears directly on the horizon.
